lesson.title: Agriculture in Yemen
lesson.title_ar: الزراعة في اليمن: المناطق الخمس وتلخيص النص في جدول

lines: Information presented in a written passage can sometimes be shortened and presented in the form of a table. It is easier and quicker to find information using a table.
Scan these five paragraphs about agriculture in Northern Yemen. What type of information is in each paragraph? Would the information be easier to understand in table form?

The climate in the Northern part of Yemen can be divided into five areas or zones. In the Tihamah on the Red Sea (sea level to 300m) the climate is tropical. The air is hot and humid in the summer and pleasantly warm in the winter. Dates and cotton grow well here, as do vegetables and grains, which are both a winter and summer crop.

Further up the Western mountain slopes, in Zone 2 (300 - 2,200m), the climate becomes subtropical, then moderate. Fruit typical of this area are mangoes, papayas and bananas. The highest parts of the slopes have a moderate climate with rather cold winter nights. It is here that Yemen's most famous crop, coffee, is grown.

The Central Highlands (2,200-3,700m) also have a moderate climate. All kinds of grain crops, such as sorghum, are grown on the mountain terraces. Many types of fruit are found here, including apricots, peaches and figs. In the more protected wadi beds, where there is also more water, apples, pears, oranges, lemons and grapes are grown. Yemen has more than twenty different types of grape, some seedless, each of a different colour.

[Photo caption: Agriculture in the mountains] On the Eastern mountain slopes (2,300 -1,100m), the climate again becomes subtropical. There is much less rainfall than in the Highlands and farming takes place mostly in the wadis. In these wadis, which lead to the desert, grapes and some fruit trees can be found. In the lower areas close to the Ruba' Al Khali, there are date and palm trees.

Further east in the yellow sands of the desert (1,000m), very little grows. For a short time after the rains, a little grass may appear. Apart from this and a few shrubs, there is no other vegetation.
Read this text again carefully and transfer the information to the table in Workbook activity A.
Now do activities B and C in the Workbook.

activities.prompt_literal: 4.4 A Use the information on PB page 27 to fill in this table. The first part has been done for you as an example.
activities.prompt_ar: استكمل خانات الجدول الخمس (Height in metres / Climate / Vegetation) للمناطق 2–5 اعتماداً على PB ص 27 (المنطقة 1 محلولة):

items.question: Zone 1 — The Tihamah (already given in WB)
items.model_answer: Height in metres: 0 to 300 | Climate: tropical | Vegetation: dates, cotton, vegetables, grain
items.explain_ar: محلولة مثالاً في العمود الأول من الجدول.

items.question: Zone 2 — Western mountain slopes
items.model_answer: Height in metres: 300 to 2,200 | Climate: subtropical, then moderate | Vegetation: mangoes, papayas, bananas, coffee
items.explain_ar: يُنبت البن في أعلى أجزاء المنحدرات ذات المناخ المعتدل والشتاء البارد ليلاً.

items.question: Zone 3 — Central Highlands
items.model_answer: Height in metres: 2,200 to 3,700 | Climate: moderate | Vegetation: grain crops (sorghum), apricots, peaches, figs, apples, pears, oranges, lemons, grapes
items.explain_ar: تزرع الحبوب والمشمش والخوخ والتين على المدرجات، وبقية الفاكهة والأعناب في بطون الأودية.

items.question: Zone 4 — Eastern mountain slopes
items.model_answer: Height in metres: 2,300 to 1,100 (descending eastwards) | Climate: subtropical | Vegetation: grapes, some fruit trees, date and palm trees
items.explain_ar: الأمطار أقل بكثير وتتركز الزراعة في الأودية، والنخيل في المناطق المنخفضة قرب الربع الخالي.

items.question: Zone 5 — Yellow sands of the desert
items.model_answer: Height in metres: 1,000 | Climate: desert (dry) | Vegetation: a little grass (after rains), a few shrubs
items.explain_ar: لا ينمو فيها سوى القليل من العشب بعد المطر وبعض الشجيرات.

hints: راجع العمود الأول (Zone 1) لمعرفة الأسلوب الموجز المتّبع في تعبئة الجدول بدون جمل طويلة.

activities.prompt_literal: 4.4 B Discuss with your partner similar information about Southern Yemen (zone name, climate, vegetation). C Use the information you have discussed to write five sentences in your copybook about Southern Yemen.
activities.prompt_ar: لخّص خمس جمل وصفية منظَّمة عن مناطق جنوب وشرق اليمن (الساحل، المرتفعات، والوديان كحضرموت) على غرار نص الدرس:
activities.guidance_literal: Zone name(s) → Climate → Crops & Vegetation → 5 complete sentences

steps.placeholder: In the southern coastal plains of Aden and Abyan, the climate is hot and humid in summer and warm in winter.

steps.label_ar: 2) محاصيل الساحل والوديان والمرتفعات (5 جمل كاملة)
steps.placeholder:
1. The climate in Southern Yemen varies from tropical on the coast to moderate in the highlands.
2. Along the coastal plains such as Abyan, cotton, bananas, mangoes and vegetables are grown.
3. In higher areas such as Dhalea and Yafa', coffee and grain crops are cultivated.
4. Wadi Hadramaut is famous for its date palms and honey.
5. Further inland towards the desert sands, rainfall is scarce and only a few shrubs grow.

hints: وظّف مفردات الدرس: tropical, moderate, wadis, crops, vegetables, palm trees, shrubs.

questions.stem: According to PB page 27, where is coffee ('Yemen's most famous crop') grown?

options.text: On the highest parts of the Western mountain slopes (Zone 2, 300 - 2,200m, moderate climate)
In the Tihamah on the Red Sea (sea level to 300m)
options.why_wrong: تُزرع في تهامة التمور والقطن والخضراوات والحبوب وليس البن.

options.text: In the yellow sands of the eastern desert (1,000m)
options.why_wrong: الصحراء الشرقية لا تنبت إلا قليلاً من العشب وبعض الشجيرات.

options.text: In the lower areas close to the Ruba' Al Khali
options.why_wrong: المنطقة القريبة من الربع الخالي تشتهر بأشجار التمر والنخيل.

hints: اقرأ السطر الأخير من الفقرة الثانية في PB ص 27.
questions.explain: ذكرت الفقرة الثانية نصياً: The highest parts of the slopes have a moderate climate with rather cold winter nights. It is here that Yemen's most famous crop, coffee, is grown.

questions.stem: Which two zones share a 'subtropical' climate according to PB page 27?

options.text: Zone 2 (Western mountain slopes) and Zone 4 (Eastern mountain slopes)

options.why_wrong: مناخ تهامة استوائي (tropical) ومناخ المرتفعات الوسطى معتدل (moderate).
الفقرتان 2 و4 هما اللتان ذكرتا المناخ شبه المداري subtropical.

hints: ابحث عن كلمة subtropical في الفقرات الخمس لكتاب الطالب ص 27.
questions.explain: تبدأ المنحدرات الغربية (Zone 2) بشبه المداري، وتعود المنحدرات الشرقية (Zone 4) إلى المناخ شبه المداري ثانيةً.
